note:
身份: Torrhus 泉边的救生员，讲解潜水准备
关系: 提醒玩家注意安全，玩家溺水时出手救援
说话方式: 朴素口语，先讲要点，再带点调侃
性格与词汇: 尽责，但不想休息日还忙着救人；压力、抗压、水下呼吸
禁用风格: 不写成正式公告，不爆粗，不凭空补钓鱼或狩猎技能机制；Dory、Nemo 保留原名
color_source: 普通社区 Wiki 呈现页的 DOM computed 样式；raw 为页面颜色还原样本，不是服务器原始字节或实测。

entries.context: Dory 日常对话：介绍 Torrhus 泉的深度；Wiki 条件为 None。
entries.raw: §bTorrhus Springs §fbeing so high up means they run down super deep.
entries.text: Torrhus Springs being so high up means they run down super deep.
entries.gloss: 不凭 Springs 自行增译温度。Torrhus Springs 已统一为 Torrhus 泉，与最新实测章节导航、传送门/传送卷轴及 _shared/Terms.json 一致；不推断为温泉。
entries.zh: Torrhus 泉的位置这么高，往下自然也深得很。

segments.text: being so high up means they run down super deep.
segments.zh: 的位置这么高，往下自然也深得很。

entries.context: Dory 日常对话：说明潜得越深，压力越大；Wiki 条件为 None。
entries.raw: §fThe further down you go, the more §9Pressure §fbuilds up.
entries.text: The further down you go, the more Pressure builds up.
entries.gloss: Pressure 指潜水压力，沿用 Hub_General/GUI_Lore/Stats_Breakdown_Live.json#stats_pressure 的压力，不是防御力或抗压属性本身。

entries.context: Dory 日常对话：提醒玩家在潜水前确认抗压和水下呼吸足够；Wiki 条件为 None。
entries.raw: §fIf you're thinking of taking a dive, make sure you've got enough §9 Pressure Resistance §fand §3 Respiration §fto reach your destination.
entries.text: If you're thinking of taking a dive, make sure you've got enough  Pressure Resistance and  Respiration to reach your destination.
entries.gloss: Pressure Resistance / Respiration 沿用 _shared/Terms.json 的抗压 / 水下呼吸及 _shared/Stats_Equipment_Live.json#stat_live_2367729aad0fd3、#stat_live_d4573c451a6fde 的属性图标。、 尚无 Glyphs.java 通用符号映射，原样保留；这里是潜水属性，不是物品请求或附魔等级。
entries.zh: 想潜下去的话，先确保  抗压和  水下呼吸足够，能撑到目的地才行。

segments.text: If you're thinking of taking a dive, make sure you've got enough

segments.zh: 足够，能撑到目的地才行。

entries.context: Dory 日常对话：半开玩笑地抱怨不想在休息日救人；Wiki 条件为 None。
entries.raw: §fLast thing I want to be doing on my day off work is hauling your butt out of there.
entries.text: Last thing I want to be doing on my day off work is hauling your butt out of there.
entries.gloss: hauling your butt out of there 是把玩家从水里救出来的口语说法，不逐字翻屁股，也不增添粗口。
entries.zh: 我可不想休息的时候，还得把你从水里捞出来。

entries.context: 玩家在 Torrhus 泉溺水后，Dory 救援并调侃玩家险些丧命。
entries.raw: §fPhew, you were almost a goner there. Good thing I'm a lifeguard, huh?
entries.text: Phew, you were almost a goner there. Good thing I'm a lifeguard, huh?
entries.gloss: lifeguard 为救生员；goner 指险些没命，不添加死亡惩罚或恢复数值。
entries.zh: 呼，刚才你差点就没命了。还好我是救生员，对吧?

entries.context: 玩家在 Torrhus 泉溺水后，Dory 提醒再次潜水前检查抗压和水下呼吸。
entries.raw: §fBefore diving down again, ensure you have enough §9 Pressure Resistance §fand §3 Respiration§f.
entries.text: Before diving down again, ensure you have enough  Pressure Resistance and  Respiration.
entries.gloss: 抗压 / 水下呼吸沿用 _shared/Terms.json 与 _shared/Stats_Equipment_Live.json#stat_live_2367729aad0fd3、#stat_live_d4573c451a6fde；保留原文属性图标及 §9 / §3 颜色。
entries.zh: 再潜下去之前，先确认  抗压和  水下呼吸都够用。

entries.context: 玩家在 Torrhus 泉溺水后，Dory 推荐到暗水湖向朋友 Nemo 购买补给。
entries.raw: §fMy buddy §bNemo §fover in §2Murkwater Loch §fsells some supplies, if you need them.
entries.text: My buddy Nemo over in Murkwater Loch sells some supplies, if you need them.
entries.gloss: Nemo 为 NPC 人名，保留原文。Murkwater Loch 沿用 Hub_General/GUI_Lore/NEU_Equipment.json#neu_c6cfc6beeaff、#neu_40f427df511c 的暗水湖。supplies 仅为泛称补给，未出现所需物品整名，不能补造装备名或商店清单。
entries.zh: 我朋友 Nemo 在暗水湖卖补给，需要的话可以去看看。

segments.text: sells some supplies, if you need them.
segments.zh: 卖补给，需要的话可以去看看。
